scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check on the status of my application. Could you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been approved and was purchased by Ginnie Mae. You were approved for an FHA:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. Could you also tell me what my interest rate is and the total costs of this loan? Additionally, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.5%. The total costs of your loan are $13,768.99. Your loan is not a high-cost mortgage and does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for that information. Could you also tell me what my debt-to-income ratio is and if that had any impact on my application?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include your debt-to-income ratio. The record also does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot confirm if it impacted your application.

dialogue.user:
I see. Well, thank you for the information you were able to provide. I appreciate your help.

<Neutral> - I was able to get most of the information I needed, but I wish I could have learned more about how my debt-to-income ratio affected my application.
